src/sim/state.ts WorldState {
  beds: {
    lastWateredDay: null | number
    n: number
    plantedDay: number
    planterId: null | string
    wateredDays: number
  }[]
  eventSeq: number
  firsts: string[]
  jobOffers: {
    employerId: string
    expires: number
    hours: number
    id: number
    startHour: number
    wage: number
    workerId: string
  }[]
  jobs: {
    employerId: string
    hours: number
    id: number
    lastWorkedDay: null | number
    placeId: string
    startHour: number
    wage: number
    workerId: string
  }[]
  ledgerSeq: number
  lorryHere: false | true
  nextId: number
  notes: {
    authorId: string
    id: number
    t: number
    text: string
  }[]
  owed: {
    cents: number
    employerId: string
    workerId: string
  }[]
  residents: {
    activity: null | {
      dest: null | string
      kind: "walking"
      path: {
        x: number
        y: number
      }[]
      thenSleep: false | true
    } | {
      jobId: number
      kind: "working"
      until: number
      worked: number
    } | {
      kind: "fishing"
      until: number
    } | {
      kind: "sleeping"
      reason: "collapse" | "nap" | "night"
      until: null | number
    }
    energy: number
    homeId: string
    hunger: number
    id: string
    items: {
      bread?: number | undefined
      coffee?: number | undefined
      fish?: number | undefined
      "fish porridge"?: number | undefined
      kopi?: number | undefined
      rice?: number | undefined
      "vegetable rice"?: number | undefined
      vegetables?: number | undefined
    }
    knownPeople: string[]
    knownPlaces: string[]
    money: number
    name: string
    pos: {
      x: number
      y: number
    }
    recent: {
      t: number
      talk?: true | undefined
      text: string
    }[]
    reply: null | {
      ok: false | true
      text: string
    }
    role: "owner" | "seeker"
    thinkAt: number
  }[]
  rng: number
  seed: number
  shops: {
    buyLimits: {
      bread?: number | undefined
      coffee?: number | undefined
      fish?: number | undefined
      "fish porridge"?: number | undefined
      kopi?: number | undefined
      rice?: number | undefined
      "vegetable rice"?: number | undefined
      vegetables?: number | undefined

      bread?: number | undefined

      "fish porridge"?: number | undefined
      kopi?: number | undefined
      rice?: number | undefined
      "vegetable rice"?: number | undefined
      vegetables?: number | undefined

    id: string
    ownerId: string
    sellPrices: {
      bread?: number | undefined
      coffee?: number | undefined
      fish?: number | undefined
      "fish porridge"?: number | undefined
      kopi?: number | undefined
      rice?: number | undefined
      "vegetable rice"?: number | undefined
      vegetables?: number | undefined
    }
    stock: {
      bread?: number | undefined
      coffee?: number | undefined
      fish?: number | undefined
      "fish porridge"?: number | undefined
      kopi?: number | undefined
      rice?: number | undefined
      "vegetable rice"?: number | undefined
      vegetables?: number | undefined
    }
  }[]
  t: number
  talk: {
    [key: string]: {
      lastT: number
      lines: number
    }
  }
  trades: {
    expires: number
    fromId: string
    give: {
      cents: number
      items: {
        bread?: number | undefined

}

src/brain/fake-brain.ts Memory {
  buyDays: {
    [key: string]: string
  }
  lorryDay: null | string
  rng: number
}

src/mind/mind.ts MindState {
  budget: {
    lastT: number
    level: number
  }
  businessCalls: number
  businessDay: null | number
  model?: unknown
  plan: null | string
  planDay: null | number
  reflectedDay: null | number
}

Tables of a fresh save:
CREATE TABLE events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, t INTEGER NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE ledger (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, t INTEGER NOT NULL, from_id TEXT NOT NULL, to_id TEXT NOT NULL, cents INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE memories (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, resident TEXT NOT NULL, t INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, importance INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE snapshot (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), t INTEGER NOT NULL, world TEXT NOT NULL, brains TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX memories_by_resident ON memories (resident, t);
